shots.content: Inside a kitchen, a long rectangular island stands between the refrigerator wall and the sink area, with stools arranged along its sides. A man in a blue shirt sits on the sink-side guest stool and proposes preparing breakfast this morning, while a man in a purple shirt sits on the sink-end stool.
shots.viewpoint: Wide establishing shot from the refrigerator end, looking lengthwise along the kitchen island toward the sink area, with both guest-side stools and the sink-end stool in frame.

shots.content: A woman in a yellow shirt enters and sits on the refrigerator-side guest stool. She asks about the housekeeping chores, and a man in a blue shirt replies that the cooking is simple.
shots.viewpoint: Medium two-shot from the cook side, centered on the two adjacent guest-side stools.

shots.content: A man in a blue shirt admits that preparing the meal is far more demanding than expected.
shots.viewpoint: Reverse wide shot from the sink end, looking lengthwise along the kitchen island toward the refrigerator wall, with both guest-side stools and the sink-end stool in frame.
